India Rejects OIC Remarks on Kashmir as 'Factually Incorrect'

India has rejected remarks made by the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) regarding Jammu and Kashmir, stating they are 'unwarranted' and 'factually incorrect'. The Ministry of External Affairs asserted that the entire Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are integral parts of India, and the OIC has 'no locus standi' to comment on the matter. This statement follows Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan raising the Kashmir issue during an address to world leaders.
